test_title: PYST 39: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All shrubs are plants.

Some herbs are plants.

**Conclusions:**

I. All shrubs being herbs is a possibility.

II. No herb is a shrub.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given,

__Statements__:

All shrubs are plants.

Some herbs are plants.

**__Venn Diagram__:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/265d81333d3f08deed71c50f8cebcda7add008b20cfad12e94461ce21bedf4c0.png] 

__**Conclusions**__**:**

I. All shrubs being herbs is a possibility.→ **True **(Some plants are herbs, so all shrubs can be herbs)

II. No herb is a shrub. → **False **(No definite relation.)

Hence, the correct answer is "__**Only conclusion I follows.**__"
